reason: I'd use the free visit on a Saturday since a clean, not-packed place where I can sit with the baby sounds good. If it holds up I'd come back maybe once or twice a month, but it's a drive and I'm not signing up for a membership on a weekends-only schedule.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and I only have Saturdays, so $15 plus gas plus coffee for a couple of hours has to really beat the free playground or the library.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price closer to the weekday $13, or a 5-pack that works out clearly cheaper per visit, plus proof it's really never crowded on Saturdays.
